# An un-sized ComboBox or Country field collapses its input in align-start containers

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Surfaced during `#21178` (`examples/grid/nestedRecordFields/EditUserDialog.mjs`, which instructs: *"If the narrow Country field is an engine defect, file it and work around it here"*). Inside a `Neo.container.Base` or `Neo.dialog.Base` `bodyContainer` where fields carry no explicit `width`, `Neo.form.field.Text` and `Neo.form.field.Date` render a normal-width input (~`150 px` in `align: 'start'`, full container width in `align: 'stretch'`), while `Neo.form.field.ComboBox` and subclasses (`Country`, `Chip`, `Color`) collapse their input box when `labelPosition` is `'left'` (the `TextField` default) so the value text (`"Germany"`) overlaps the clear and picker triggers or disappears completely.

## The Problem

Two coupled engine defaults interact to crush un-sized `ComboBox` subclasses:
1. `ComboBox` (`typeAhead: true` by default) wraps the input and typeahead overlay in `.neo-input-field-wrapper` and takes **both** `<input>` elements out of flow (`position: absolute; inset: 0` in `resources/css/src/form/field/ComboBox.css:2-9`), leaving `.neo-input-field-wrapper` with zero intrinsic content width and only `flex: 1 1 30px`.
2. To work around that collapsed intrinsic width in inline-label demos (`#6914`), `src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs:166` hardcoded `width: 150` on `ComboBox.config`. Because `Neo.form.field.Text` defaults `labelPosition` to `'left'` and `labelWidth` to `150`, `width: 150` caps the *entire* `label + input + triggers` box to `150 px` (`150 - 150 = 0 px` remaining for the input wrapper), and its inline `style="width: 150px"` also prevents `ComboBox`, `Country`, `Chip`, and `Color` from stretching inside `align: 'stretch'` containers!

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/form/field/ComboBox.css:2-9`: both `.neo-textfield-input` and `.neo-typeahead-input` use `position: absolute; inset: 0`.
- `src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs:161-166`: `width: 150` (`#6914`, `"Default width to prevent rendering issues."`) overrides `Neo.component.Base`'s `width: null`.
- `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css:403-410`: `.neo-input-wrapper { display: flex; flex: 1 1 1px; }`.
- Subclass sweep (`get_class_hierarchy`): `Neo.form.field.Country`, `Neo.form.field.Chip`, and `Neo.form.field.Color` all extend `Neo.form.field.ComboBox` without overriding `width`.
- Design authority: `src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs:38` (`@extends Neo.form.field.Picker`) — a `ComboBox` without an explicit `width` in the same `vbox` container as `TextField` / `DateField` is expected to size and stretch identically rather than collapsing onto its triggers.

## The Fix

*(Stage-2 Prescription checked at intake: `resources/css/src/form/field/ComboBox.css` + `src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs` — together own the concern; `ComboBox.css` restores intrinsic `<input>` sizing, retiring `ComboBox.mjs`'s `#6914` `width: 150` workaround.)*
1. In `resources/css/src/form/field/ComboBox.css`, keep `.neo-textfield-input:not(.neo-typeahead-input)` in normal flow inside `.neo-input-field-wrapper` (`display: flex; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; position: relative` on `.neo-input-field-wrapper`, `position: relative; z-index: 1; min-width: 0` on the real input) while only `.neo-typeahead-input` uses `position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none`, and remove the obsolete `width: 150` default in `src/form/field/ComboBox.mjs` so `ComboBox` and its subclasses inherit `width: null` like `TextField` and `Picker`. Rebuild themes (`npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`).
2. Add a browser component spec in `test/playwright/component/form/field/ComboBox.spec.mjs` mounting `TextField`, `ComboBox` (`left` and `inline`), and `Country` inside an `align: 'start'` `Neo.container.Base` (no explicit `width`) plus an explicitly constrained `width: 120` `ComboBox`, asserting readable `>= 120 px` input widths matching `TextField`, zero trigger overlap, 1:1 typeahead overlay alignment, and clean `120 px` shrink without overflow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Inside an `align: 'start'` `Neo.container.Base` (no explicit `width` on the container or field), `Neo.form.field.ComboBox` (`left` and `inline` labels) and `Neo.form.field.Country` render an input area at least `120 px` wide with zero overlap between text and triggers, and stretch cleanly inside `align: 'stretch'` containers.
- [ ] AC-2: When an explicit `width` or `align: 'stretch'` constrains a `ComboBox` (including grid cell editors and narrow toolbars), the field respects that width without horizontal overflow.
- [ ] AC-3: `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` succeeds cleanly across all themes.
- [ ] AC-4: A Playwright spec reproduces the collapsed width on `dev` and passes at head.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Neo.container.Panel`'s default `bodyContainer` alignment across all panels/dialogs.
- Renewing `examples/grid/nestedRecordFields` (handled in #21178).

## Avoided Traps

- Setting a rigid `min-width: 180px` on `.neo-combobox` itself, which would break compact toolbar/header-filter comboboxes explicitly configured with `width: 100` or `width: 120` — keeping the real `<input>` in normal flow with `min-width: 0` preserves shrinkability.
